tools.name: msfs_status
tools.description: Report the flight state right now: flight phase, altitude, height above ground, airspeed, mach, vertical speed, ground speed, attitude, heading, and whether the aircraft is on the ground. Read-only; do not poll it on a timer.

summary.zh: 报出此刻的阶段、高度、空速、马赫、垂直速度、姿态、航向和地面状态。
summary.en: Reports phase, altitude, airspeed, mach, vertical speed, attitude, heading and ground state right now.

tools.name: msfs_ap
tools.description: Report the autopilot: whether it is engaged, which lateral and vertical modes are active, and the selected target altitude, heading, speed and vertical speed. Read-only.

summary.zh: 报出自动驾驶的接通状态、当前模式，以及选定的高度、航向、速度和垂直速度。
summary.en: Reports autopilot engagement, active modes and the selected altitude, heading, speed and vertical speed.

tools.name: msfs_nav
tools.description: Report radio and navigation: COM1/2 and NAV1/2 frequencies, transponder code and mode, localizer and glideslope deviation, DME distance, and the next GPS waypoint with its distance and bearing. Read-only.

summary.zh: 报出 COM/NAV 频率、应答机、下滑道与航向道偏差、DME 距离和下一个航路点。
summary.en: Reports COM/NAV frequencies, transponder, glideslope and localizer deviation, DME and the next waypoint.

tools.name: msfs_wx
tools.description: Report the environment around the aircraft: wind, outside temperature, altimeter setting, visibility and precipitation. Read-only.

summary.zh: 报出风、外界温度、气压基准、能见度和降水。
summary.en: Reports wind, outside temperature, altimeter setting, visibility and precipitation.

tools.name: msfs_alerts
tools.description: Report which warnings are active right now: stall, overspeed, structural icing, deviation from the selected altitude, and landing gear state. Read-only.

summary.zh: 报出此刻哪些告警亮着：失速、超速、结冰、高度偏离和起落架状态。
summary.en: Reports which warnings are active: stall, overspeed, icing, altitude deviation and gear state.

tools.name: msfs_radio
tools.description: Set a radio or instrument value: COM or NAV frequency in MHz, transponder code as a four-digit number, or altimeter setting in inches of mercury. Refuses with the reason when the operator has not enabled that write permission.

target.description: Which radio or instrument to set.

value.description: COM/NAV frequency in MHz (e.g. 118.7), transponder code as a four-digit number (e.g. 1200), or altimeter setting in inches of mercury (e.g. 29.92).

summary.zh: 设 COM/NAV 频率、应答机码或气压基准；操作者没开放的那一项会明确拒绝。
summary.en: Sets COM/NAV frequency, transponder code or altimeter setting; refuses when the operator has not enabled it.

tools.name: msfs_switch
tools.description: Flip a switch: landing, nav, strobe, taxi or beacon lights, or raise/lower the landing gear. Refuses with the reason when the operator has not enabled that write permission.

on.description: For lights: true turns it on, false turns it off. For the gear: true lowers it, false raises it.

summary.zh: 开关灯光或收放起落架；操作者没开放的那一项会明确拒绝。
summary.en: Flips lights or raises/lowers the gear; refuses when the operator has not enabled it.

tools.name: msfs_ap_set
tools.description: Change the autopilot: engage or disengage it, switch heading/altitude/nav hold on or off, or set the target altitude, heading, speed or vertical speed. Refuses with the reason when the operator has not enabled the autopilot write permission.

target.description: What to change. master/heading/altitude/nav are switches; target_* set a reference value.

on.description: For switches: true engages, false disengages. Ignored for target_*.

value.description: For target_altitude: feet. target_heading: degrees 0-360. target_speed: knots. target_vs: feet per minute (may be negative).

summary.zh: 改自动驾驶：接通/断开、开关航向/高度/NAV/速度/垂直速度保持、自动油门预位，设目标高度/航向/速度/垂直速度；没开放权限时明确拒绝。
summary.en: Changes the autopilot: engage/disengage, heading/altitude/nav/speed/vertical-speed hold, autothrottle arm, and target altitude/heading/speed/vertical speed; refuses when not enabled.

description.zh: 连上 SimConnect 了，正文带机型与当前阶段。
description.en: SimConnect is connected; the text carries the aircraft title and current phase.

description.zh: 和模拟器的连接断了，正文带原因。
description.en: The link to the simulator dropped; the text carries the reason.

description.zh: 飞机离地，正文带离地速度、抬轮姿态和航向。
description.en: The aircraft lifted off; the text carries liftoff speed, rotation attitude and heading.

description.zh: 爬升结束进入巡航，正文带巡航高度、马赫和空速。
description.en: Climb ended and cruise began; the text carries cruise altitude, mach and airspeed.

description.zh: 开始下降，正文带当前高度、下降率和空速。
description.en: Descent began; the text carries current altitude, descent rate and airspeed.

description.zh: 截获下滑道，正文带距离、高度和航向道偏差。
description.en: The glideslope was captured; the text carries distance, altitude and localizer deviation.

description.zh: 接地，正文带下沉率、接地俯仰、坡度和航向。
description.en: Touchdown; the text carries sink rate, touchdown pitch, bank and heading.

description.zh: 失速警告响，正文带空速、俯仰和离地高度。
description.en: The stall warning fired; the text carries airspeed, pitch and height above ground.

description.zh: 超速警告响，正文带马赫、空速和高度。
description.en: The overspeed warning fired; the text carries mach, airspeed and altitude.

description.zh: 偏离自动驾驶选定高度，正文带选定值、实际值和偏差。
description.en: The aircraft drifted from the selected altitude; the text carries selected, actual and deviation.

changelog.0.1.5:
- README 补上 `msfs_ap_set` 与 `writeAp`，删掉「自动驾驶没做」这句过时的话。
- CHANGELOG 补齐 0.1.2–0.1.4 的条目。
changelog.0.1.4:
- 事件正文统一加 `[MSFS-2020]` 前缀，和用户发言区分开。
- `msfs_ap_set` 增加 `speed`、`vs`、`autothrottle` 三个动作。
changelog.0.1.3:
- **事件不再冒充 user 消息**：`origin` 从 `internal` 改为 `external`。框架里 `internal` 的正文无条件拼进 user 消息，只有 `external` 才按 `eventDelivery`（默认 `tool`）走合成工具回执。
- 新增 4 个航路变量：`GPS FLIGHTPLAN TOTAL DISTANCE`、`GPS WP ETE`、`GPS ETE`、`GPS WP NEXT ALT`。`msfs_nav` 现在报全程、下一航路点、到目的地预计时间；剩余距离按 `ETE × 地速` 估算。
- 新增 `msfs_ap_set` 工具与 `writeAp` 配置（默认关）：接通/断开、航向/高度/NAV 保持、目标高度/航向/速度/垂直速度。
- 桥接的事件参数改为按有符号解析，`target_vs` 可以传负数。
changelog.0.1.2: - 去掉 `panels` 声明。面板需要单独的前端构建产物（`cortico.webUiClient`），本包没有打包 React 组件，声明了会导致面板页签加载失败。状态改由 `lamps` 和 `msfs_status` 提供。
changelog.0.1.1:
真机联调（Boeing 747-8i，2026-11-12）。修掉五个会让整条数据链路「一个字都收不到」的问题：

- `SIMCONNECT_PERIOD` 枚举值：`SECOND` 是 4，不是 1。
- `SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID` 枚举值：`OPEN=2`、`QUIT=3`、`EVENT=4`。把 2 当成 `QUIT` 会让泵线程在连接成功后几十毫秒就退出。
- `AddToDataDefinition` 的 `DatumID`：传 `0` 不是「自动分配」，同一定义里所有变量共用一个 ID 会互相覆盖，必须传 `SIMCONNECT_UNUSED`。
- 单位名：`enum`、`mask`、`BCD16` 都不在 SimConnect 的单位表里，改用 `number` 后自行解码。
- `SIMCONNECT_DATATYPE_STRING256` 是 9，不是 11；11 是 `STRINGV`（变长），会让周期性请求一律回 `DEFINITION_ERROR`。

架构调整：

- 命令处理移到主线程，派发单独一个泵线程，改用非阻塞的 `GetNextDispatch`。此前派发循环一阻塞，命令就永远排队。
- stdin/stdout 自己开无 BOM 的 UTF-8 流，不再依赖控制台代码页。
- 新增 `PROBEALL` 逐变量体检：每个变量单独定义、单次请求，一次性找出无效的名字或单位。
- 新增 `msfs-bridge.log`，记录命令、连接握手、异常码与 `sendId`/`index`。

遥测：

- 新增 `SIM DISABLED`，用于判断模拟是否停住。
- 移除并不存在的 `SIMULATION RATE` SimVar；`msfs.simRate` 模板变量改为如实报「未提供」。
- `xpndrCode` 同时兼容十进制与 BCD 两种应答机码返回形态。
changelog.0.1.0:
首个版本。

- SimConnect 桥接：C# 控制台程序自己 P/Invoke 原生 `SimConnect.dll`，不依赖 MSFS SDK 的托管封装；首次连接时用系统 `csc.exe` 编译，之后按源码 mtime 复用。
- 遥测：66 个 SimVar，覆盖飞行状态、自动驾驶、无线电与导航、天气环境、告警、灯光与起落架回读、接地参数、机型与仿真倍率。
- 飞行阶段推断：停机、滑行、起飞滑跑、爬升、巡航、下降、进近、着陆、滑跑，带 1.2 秒滞后。
- 事件：离地、到达巡航、开始下降、进近建立、接地、失速、超速、高度偏离，以及连接与断开。每项可单独关闭。
- 工具：`msfs_status`、`msfs_ap`、`msfs_nav`、`msfs_wx`、`msfs_alerts` 只读；`msfs_radio`、`msfs_switch` 写操作，默认全关、逐项打开。
- 单位：航空单位（英尺、节、海里、英寸汞柱）为默认，可切公制。
- 提示词模板变量：`msfs.connected`、`msfs.aircraft`、`msfs.phase`、`msfs.simRate`、`msfs.paused`、`msfs.units`。
- 连接失败不阻塞挂载：工具返回明确原因，插件每 5 秒重试。
